# Microsoft runtime license reference provenance

Text in Microsoft-Visual-Studio-2022-Community-License.txt is extracted from
all paragraphs (including tables) of the official Microsoft license document:
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/Visual-Studio-2022-Community-License-EN.docx
linked by https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2022-ga-community/
Retrieved 2026-10-01. Formatting is flattened; the substantive text is preserved.

This is the Visual Studio license reference for the redistributable code
conditions, not a claim that Tower Tools or OpenJFX is licensed under those
terms. The Microsoft runtime DLLs remain separate proprietary redistributable
components. The same-version Gluon SDK contains no independent Microsoft
license text for them. Official list and distribution conditions:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution
